name: @papercusp/artifact-registry
description: A generic artifact registry: publish/install distributable artifacts (plugins, snapshots, blueprints, packages…) over a pluggable storage backend. Content-addressed blob store (hash-verified put/get, idempotent dedupe, visibility-gated download, refcounted GC) behind a BlobStore port, plus an ArtifactRegistry over a ListingStore port (publish-with-dedup, list, get, unlist+GC, claim) with the domain — kinds, identity/trust, validation — injected. Zero coupling: no Cloudflare, no SQL, no HTTP framework. Web-Crypto only.
